    Player Bio - Karim Adeyemi

    Karim Adeyemi is a professional footballer from Germany. He is a 180cm | 5'11" tall, left-footed midfielder (RM) who plays for FC Barcelona in LALIGA EA SPORTS. He was born on 18-01-2002 and he is now 24 years old.

    His real-life stats are currently 2 goals and 2 assists in 7 matches in domestic competition. He also received 1 yellow card(s) and 0 red card(s).

    FC 27 Ones to Watch - Karim Adeyemi

    Karim Adeyemi's Ones to Watch card is rated 83. He has a 3-star weak foot and 3-star skill moves. He does not have a real face in-game. Karim Adeyemi has 1 special card with rating 82.
